conservativeness_of_the_foreign_m1_readi.verdict: CONFIRMED: unsharp, not wrong -- subject to the stated proof-reading caveat
conservativeness_of_the_foreign_m1_readi.monotonicity: dL/dChat^2 = -(m_k+sigma)^2/(1+Chat^2(m_k+sigma))^2 < 0 for m_k+sigma > 0, and dChat^2/dm_1 = -eta_V^2/((1-eps) nu_star (m_1+sigma)^2) < 0, so dL/dm_1 > 0 strictly: replacing m_1 by any smaller value strictly LOWERS L. For the analytic route eta_V^2 = eps/(1-eps) + Ceps/(m_1+sigma) also decreases in m_1, reinforcing the same direction.
conservativeness_of_the_foreign_m1_readi.coercivity: the substitution is legitimate exactly when m_1 enters only through a_sigma(v_N,v_N) >= (m_1+sigma)||v_N||^2 on the trial space. mu_{1,N} is the minimum of the Rayleigh quotient over V_N, so that inequality holds on V_N^oee with its own mu_{1,N}^oee and hence a fortiori with any smaller constant. The eee m_1 is smaller in every configuration (verified: 11/11).
conservativeness_of_the_foreign_m1_readi.caveat: I cannot check this against the paper's own statement of Theorem 8: the form-factor certificates themselves record that the paper's Remark app:rem:si-tail is not in the reproduction bundle. The confirmation is of the monotonicity (exact arithmetic) and of the coercivity reading that the code implements; it is not a verification of the published theorem's hypotheses.

evidence.why: Two fields DO reference 86, and they are a consistency point rather than a dependency: stages.mu2.Nprime = 86 with stages.mu2.D_aux = 83248, which equals the oee certificate's own D exactly (formfactor_h3d2p8_oee_N86_sig4p634481266122737.json, field D). The configuration's recorded mu2 stage therefore ALREADY works in the same oee space at N'=86 that the form-factor run certifies; its recorded value -0.6650385472330178 was computed at that resolution and cannot move because a different bound on the same block is chosen as rho. impact_of_raising_oee_to_N86.what_does_change: only the separator fed to the Lehmann-Goerisch map, and hence L_1 -- both outputs of the unconditional chain, not recorded quantities of the certificate. The chain's own separation check rho > U_1 does not change verdict either: it holds with margin 0.07407540205919205 at N=86 against 0.018632411483570088 at N=76, i.e. it strengthens.
